Live Odds

"Live odds" refer to the constantly updated betting odds offered during a sporting event, reflecting real-time developments in the game. These odds are adjusted by betting sites like 10CRIC, based on the live progress of the event, incorporating factors such as current score, time remaining, player performances, and other dynamic variables.

Mechanics Of Live Odds

  • Real-time Data Integration: Live odds are generated by algorithms that process real-time data from the ongoing event. This data includes scores, player statistics, and game situations.
  • Odds Adjustment : As the event progresses, the odds are continuously updated to reflect the changing probabilities of various outcomes. For instance, if a cricket team starts scoring rapidly, their odds of winning shorten.
  • Betting Interface : Bettors can see the fluctuating odds on a betting platform and place bets while the event is ongoing. This requires quick decision-making as odds can change rapidly.

10CRIC's Live Betting Features Explained

  • Quick Cashout: This feature allows bettors to settle their bets before the event concludes, locking in profits or minimizing losses based on the current situation.
  • Large Selection of Sports Events to Bet In-Play: 10CRIC offers a wide range of sports events available for live betting, including cricket, football, tennis, and more.

Examples

Imagine a live T20 World Cup match between India and Australia. When the match begins, the initial odds might be:

  • India to win: 3.76
  • Australia to win: 4.56

As the match progresses, these odds will fluctuate based on real-time events:

If India scores 50 runs in the first 5 overs without losing a wicket, the odds might change to:

  • India to win: 4.20
  • Australia to win: 5.00

If Australia then takes two quick wickets, the odds could shift again to:

  • India to win: 3.35
  • Australia to win: 4.10

With the Quick Cashout feature, if you placed a bet on India to win at 3.76 and they perform well early on, you might decide to cash out your bet at improved odds of 3.35 to secure a profit before the outcome of the match is decided.

This dynamic environment makes live betting an exciting and potentially profitable activity for bettors who can make quick decisions based on the live progress of the game.

How Can I Bet Live On A Sports Event?

Betting on live events has become a widely used form of betting because it allows sports fans to place wagers as the action unfolds, while they watch the event. It is a great way to take advantage of the odds as you can view how the game is being played.

For example, if a player is looking very good during the game, then you can place money on that player to score certain runs.

Placing bets in real time during the course of a sporting event means you get to watch the game with a keen eye, get an idea of how players are performing, what team is looking strong, what player is having an off-day and all the other factors that could impact the outcome of the result.

With the real-time betting options bettors can get a vibe for the game and use it to their advantage, choosing their favourite in the match, based on how the game is being played rather than the prediction of how the game will be played. Live betting gives the player a better chance of placing successful bets as it is based on a stronger logic than the bet placed before the event.
